worldcombat.skill.clangoroussoul.summary: Dance a war chant that burns your own HP beat by beat and raises Attack, Defence, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed together. Low HP ends the dance early, and if it is interrupted the stages already gained stay.
worldcombat.skill.clangoroussoul.descrip: Each beat pays %1$s of your max HP and raises Attack, Defence, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed by %3$s, for %2$s beats.

Beats are %1$s apart; you stand still and the wind-up can be interrupted. You cannot start unless you can pay a beat and keep a reserve, and the dance stops early once the next beat cannot be paid; the stages already gained stay.
worldcombat.skill.clangoroussoul.timing: %1$s s wind-up, %2$s s recovery, %3$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.clangoroussoul.use.0: Dance before the fight to raise all five stats
worldcombat.skill.clangoroussoul.use.1: Build a full-stat trump card in the window while the enemy closes in
worldcombat.skill.clangoroussoul.use.2: Trade HP for all-round pressure while healthy
worldcombat.skill.clangoroussoul.prefere: On: up to two beats, each about 68% of the usual cost for a higher total, +1 to all five twice, but wind-up +4 ticks and cooldown +12 ticks. Off: one beat, cheaper and faster.
The health fraction required before dancing; higher means it refuses to sell HP and attacks or repositions instead.
Beyond this distance the threat no longer justifies dancing first; larger values stack stats from further away.
world_combat.move.clangoroussoul.text.we: Too little HP to keep dancing
